mixing_and_operator_boundary.a1_failure_boundary: A1 remains FAIL because the frozen source has no primitive orbit carrying an A0 arithmetic payload; the failure is not an absolute denial of primitive factorizations after a lift
mixing_and_operator_boundary.classical_cutoff_boundary: the total-variation cutoff at one-half n log n is attributed to Diaconis--Shahshahani and is not claimed as a new theorem here
mixing_and_operator_boundary.frozen_determinant_boundary: det(I-z P_n) is not the unweighted Artin--Mazur orbit determinant of a deterministic map on frozen S_n
mixing_and_operator_boundary.frozen_phase_space_boundary: on frozen S_n, P_n is not induced by a single-valued deterministic map and is not a permutation Koopman operator
mixing_and_operator_boundary.l2_identity: for a walk started at identity, squared L2 density distance equals sum_(lambda!=(n)) d_lambda^2 beta_lambda^(2k)
mixing_and_operator_boundary.owner_change_boundary: the weighted path-space product is canonical for P_n but changes the phase space and dynamical object; it is not the frozen S_n owner
mixing_and_operator_boundary.reversibility: P_n is self-adjoint for uniform measure because the central step law is inversion-invariant
mixing_and_operator_boundary.weighted_path_cycle_product: after changing to the weighted directed-edge path space of P_n, det(I-z P_n)^(-1)=product_[primitive path cycles gamma](1-w(gamma) z^|gamma|)^(-1) as a formal power series

progress_and_boundary.evidence_boundary: finite rows regression-test exact formulas; all-size conclusions rest on written representation-theoretic proofs
progress_and_boundary.prime_composite_control: prime and composite deck sizes obey the same representation-theoretic formulas
progress_and_boundary.priority_boundary: the spectrum and cutoff are classical; this package contributes a source-locked Route-A synthesis and obstruction certificate, not a priority claim
progress_and_boundary.progress: one all-size theorem joins the full partition-indexed spectrum, multiplicities, determinant, return traces, exact L2 distance, spectral gap, and the exact frozen-owner versus weighted-path-lift boundary

source_lock.allowed_data: partitions, hook lengths, exact characters at a transposition, and source-derived walk counts
source_lock.clock: one independent ordered-pair draw (i,j), followed by the transposition (i j), with (i i)=identity
source_lock.cutoff: all-n proof; exact regression uses 2<=n<=11 and moments 0<=k<=8
source_lock.determinant_convention: finite Markov determinant det(I-z P_n); on frozen S_n it is not an unweighted Artin--Mazur orbit determinant
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero or prime tables, arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya operators, and Route-B inputs
source_lock.object: lazy random-transposition Markov chain on the symmetric group S_n
source_lock.operator: central convolution P_n=(1/n^2) sum_(i,j) R_(i j) on L2(S_n)
